profile.headline: Software Engineer at MAG Aerospace
profile.summary: Software engineering professional with focus disciplines in Networking, Android Development, and Agile Project Management.  Looking to develop my knowledge in Software Design and Application Development.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Operated in a small team that produced software applications for soldier use in the field. Main area of focus was on frontend development. Additionally consolidated and fulfilled requirements provided by the customer. Debugged networks, linux services, and android applications.

positions.title: Full Stack Development Intern
positions.description: Completed Full-Stack development of User Interface using Golang, HTML, and Vue.js.  Implemented solutions for a dynamic User Interface and dynamic data-binding.  Assisted implementation of server and databases on embedded devices.

positions.title: Mechanical Engineer Intern
positions.description: Helped with the commissioning of a vacuum furnace. Interfaces with vendors for different project solutions. As well as assisting in assembly of prototype tube and shell heat exchanger. Performed Project management using Microsoft Project.

positions.title: Research Volunteer
positions.description: Contributed in Neural Engineering Laboratory to DARPA HAPTIX subcontract (PI: Yakovenko). Responsible for signal processing of kinematics, surface and intramuscular electromyography from healthy and amputee human subjects.

positions.title: Engineering Intern
positions.description: Engineering team member that assisted in the creation a test loop for supercritical CO2 heat exchangers.  Performed search and selection of vendors for various test loop components.  Used SolidWorks to create a 3D model of a test loop as well as product drawings.  Testing and assisted in commissioning of supercritical CO2 heat exchanger test loop.  Assisted in commissioning of a supercritical CO2 prototype Oxy-Combustion system.

volunteerExperiences.description: I helped to garden and keep the plants health until the harvest season cam around.  We gave the produce to the food pantry to help the needy.

projects.title: University Rover Competition
projects.description: As a member of multiple sub teams, using C++ programmed kinematics for Rover’s waypoint navigation, calculated distance of objects to Rover given Computer Vision data; currently leading the communications and user interface team.

projects.title: Finite Element Analysis
projects.description: Analyzed spring damper system on a car using Ansys given loads from weight of car and G-forces as a result of turning.  Determined meshes and element types for optimal analysis as well as appropriate acceptable boundary conditions. Checked the deflection and tensile strengths to determine areas of failure.
